items.title: Film the whole session
items.body: Prop your phone and train. MonkeyFit finds every exercise and set on its own. Confirm moves on your Watch, save at the end.

items.title: Clearer position guide
items.body: Feet on the plates, hands on the handles. Coach callouts show each joint: tap a step to zoom, or pinch.

items.title: Places know what they are
items.body: Climbing gyms, crags, resorts and trails only show for their sports. Set a home spot per sport in Your places.
